name: Blue
long_description:
Everyone pays someone to handle the parts of their life that don't need them personally. The cleaner, the bookkeeper, the lawn service. Nobody could handle what lives in your phone. Until Blue.

Blue is a small USB-C dongle and iPhone app. Plug it in and say what needs doing. The follow-up you haven't sent, the appointment you haven't booked, the reply you owe. Blue opens the right app, does the work, and tells you when it's done. You don't touch your phone.

Works with every app already on your iPhone. 

The team brings complementary experience at scale: Omar Abdelaziz led Google Assistant’s transition to LLMs and holds one of earliest patents in LLM-based computer control; Peter Krogh spent decades designing voice-first dialog systems and was most recently a design lead at Google DeepMind building actions for Gemini Live; Muhammad Farhan Hossain helped ship Apple Vision Pro, is named on dozens of hardware/systems patents, and has led products from prototype to mass production.

We’ve built systems used by billions. Now we’re on to defining the next era of computing.
one_liner: Your phone finally has someone to run it. Plug in Blue, just ask.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: I've spent more than a half-decade leading teams on Google Assistant and at Scale AI, and hold one of the world's first patents in LLM-based computer-use. Now, I'm on to defining the next era of computing, starting with a 100x more powerful voice assistant.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
I’m a robotics and product design engineer focused on building thoughtful tools for the world. I hold dozens of patents in hardware and manufacturing, and I care deeply about how things are made and who they’re made for. 

For over a decade, I’ve worked across robotics, wearables, and consumer electronics. As one of the first engineers on the Apple Vision Pro, I took it from concept to mass production.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: I teach computers how to talk. For 20 years this was primarily a deterministic process of design/engineer/tune, but with the arrival of LLMs it now looks more like show/convince/tune. AI is weird, but if it can't be taught how to have a normal spoken conversation with a person, it's not going to work. This is what I work on.

launches.title: Introducing the Blue Smart Dictation Keyboard for iPhone
launches.tagline: 4x faster when you can speak, normal keyboard when you can't
launches.body:
Blue's dictation is unlike anything you've ever tried before. Instead of transcribing what you say, we give ChatGPT the audio and we ask it: "Based on what this person said, what do you think they would have typed if they had a chance to review and edit?"

That means you can think out loud, repeat yourself, change your mind mid-sentence, and Blue still hands you something that’s ready to send. Check it out: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ED3e1ODMH3g>

So what happens when dictation finally becomes reliable? Not just better dictation for the 1% of the time your hands are tied up and you have to dictate. You start _defaulting_ to dictation every single time you have to type, and you end up saving a ton of time!

Get it right now: heyblue.com/download

launches.title: Blue: The voice assistant your phone has been missing.
launches.tagline: Blue uses your apps to finish tasks, hands-free and on the go.
launches.body:
[heyblue.com](http://heyblue.com)

**TL;DR**\
Blue is the only voice assistant on iOS and Android that can control every app on your phone, so you can get work done hands-free.

When you’re driving, you can say things like “Catch me up on Slack,” “Pay the power bill from my email,” “Help me order DoorDash”, and anything else you could ask someone in your passenger seat, and Blue will help you do it hands-free.

At launch, Blue focuses on communications journeys: messages and email across apps.

## **Why We Built Blue**

Our phone assistants peaked at setting timers and checking the weather, but we’ve got a mountain of messages and emails to work through. We built Blue because we actually want to be productive on the way to work – and for the 70% of Americans commuting just like us.

## **How Blue Works**

Blue enables full, hands-free phone control via a voice-first computer-use model. On iPhone, our tiny USB-C plug-in gives Blue the ability to tap and type on your behalf. 

Blue doesn't wait for developers to build special integrations. It just uses your apps, all of them, hands-free, so you can tackle your todo list when your hands are busy doing literally anything else.

**See it in action:**

https://youtu.be/PJV27Nd9eiI

**Team**

* **Omar Abdelaziz**: Led Google Assistant’s transition to LLMs; holds one of the earliest patents in LLM-based computer control.
* **Peter Krogh**: Decades designing voice-first dialog systems; multiple design patents; most recently design lead at Google DeepMind serving actions on Gemini Live.
* **Farhan Hossain**: Helped ship Apple Vision Pro; 50+ patents in hardware/systems; led products from prototyping to mass production and global fulfillment.

We’ve built systems used by billions. Now we’re on to defining the next era of computing.
